sentences.en: The spectators at the baseball match cheered their team on.
sentences.zh: 棒球比赛的观众们为他们的队伍加油。

sentences.en: About eighty thousand spectators packed into the stadium last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有大约八万名观众挤进了体育场。

sentences.en: The spectators in the gallery were making a lot of noise.
sentences.zh: 画廊里的观众吵得很厉害。
